name: PM-KISAN
benefits: Under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme.eligible landholding farmer families receive ₹6000 per year as financial income support. This cash amount is split into three equal installments of ₹2000 every four months and sent directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank
eligibility: landholding farmer families who are Indian citizens must own cultivable agricultural land
whoCanApply: Indian citizen family (husband, wife, minor children)Ownership of cultivable landholding in state land recordsActive bank account linked with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit TransferMandatory completion of eKYC verificationOnly one beneficiary allowed per farming family
documentsRequired: Aadhaar card, land ownership records (such as Khatauni, Khasra, or land passbook), an active bank account passbook linked with Aadhaar, and a mobile number linked to your Aadhaar for OTP verification.

name: Raitha Siri
shortDescription: The Raitha Siri Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Karnataka to support millet and high-nutrient crop growers. It provides direct financial assistance of ₹10000 per hectare to farmers cultivating millets.encouraging sustainable farming and boosting local crop production.
benefits: Gives ₹10,000 per hectare to farmers who grow millets.
eligibility: State Residency: You must live and farm in Karnataka. Land Ownership: You must own agricultural land with valid land documents such as the RTC. Crop Type: You must grow millets or other specified nutrient-rich crops such as chia, quinoa, or teff. Farmer Status: Small and marginal farmers are given priority for this direct benefit transfer.
whoCanApply: Small and marginal millet-growing farmers in Karnataka who own valid agricultural land records (RTC)
documentsRequired: an Aadhaar card, land ownership papers like the RTC (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops), a bank account passbook linked with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), residential/address proof, and an income certificate. [1, 2]

name: State Agriculture Mechanization Scheme
shortDescription: Financial assistance to farmers for purchasing eligible agricultural machinery and equipment to promote farm mechanization.
benefits: Financial assistance/subsidy for eligible agricultural machinery and equipment.
eligibility: applicants must be native landholding farmers, Self Help Groups, or Farmer Producer Organizations.
whoCanApply: Any farmer in Maharashtra with valid land ownership documents (7/12 and 8-A extracts) and an Aadhaar-linked bank account
documentsRequired: Aadhaar card, 7/12 and 8-A land extracts, a passport-size photo, bank passbook copy, a caste certificate (if SC/ST/OBC), and an authorized dealer quotation for the equipment
